sentences.text: This marine reptile reached an estimated total length between 5.5 and 6 meters.
It holds the distinction of being the first Polycotylid plesiosaur discovered in Africa.
The name Thililua comes from an ancient aquatic god in local Berber mythology.
The species name longicollis refers to the animal's long neck.
The type specimen described in 2003 includes an almost complete skull and lower jaw with 37 vertebrae.
In 2010, researchers transferred Thililua to the family Leptocleididae as a sister taxon to Nichollssaura.
Ketchum and Benson (2011) reassigned Thililua back to its original position as a Polycotylid.
Thililua fossils were found in Late Cretaceous (early Turonian) rocks in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco.
Thililua lived between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago during the Turonian stage.
